title: fix(plugin-view): the record drawer is a right-hand panel on a desktop and a bottom sheet on a phone (objectui#11775)
body:
Fixes #11775

Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

`renderDrawerForm` in `plugin-view`'s `ObjectView` opened one vaul `Drawer` with `direction="right"` on every viewport. vaul applies `direction` to its slide and drag gesture only. The shipped `DrawerContent` is the upstream bottom sheet and draws as one whatever the direction (`fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 ... rounded-t-[10px]`, a drag handle), so on a desktop the create, edit and view form drew as a sheet pinned to the bottom-left by `sm:max-w-2xl`.

## Route: the right-hand `Sheet` on a desktop (triage direction 2). No primitive is edited

The claim lets the dev choose the route. This PR uses **neither** a wrapper under `packages/components/src/custom/` **nor** a `scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs` entry. Nothing under `packages/components` changes, and `packages/components/src/ui/drawer.tsx` is untouched.

- **Desktop, 768px and up:** `Sheet` with `side="right"`. The breakpoint is `useIsMobile`, the one the record surface is already derived on. The Sheet keeps the old width classes (`w-full sm:max-w-2xl`, plus the `navigation.width` class as before) and uses `p-0` with a flex column. The header has `p-4 pr-12` so the title clears the Sheet's own close button.
- **Phone:** vaul `Drawer` in vaul's default `bottom` direction. Its `DrawerContent` takes no width classes.

### Why not a direction-aware `DrawerContent` (the four axes)

- **Real business need (measured).** `ObjectView` is the only `Drawer direction=` call site in `packages/` and `apps/`, read with `git grep` at `9990f9e`. Every side panel in the tree is already a `Sheet`:
  - `NavigationOverlay`'s `drawer` mode, which is the record view drawer;
  - `plugin-form`'s `DrawerForm`;
  - the `side` placement of `useActionModal`;
  - several console pages.

  `useActionModal` already splits the same way: `side` opens a `Sheet` and `bottom` opens a vaul `Drawer`.
- **Long-term soundness.** Each shape gets one primitive, and this adds no local-patch family to keep in step with upstream.
  - The registry this repo tracks for the drawer, `styles/default/drawer.json`, serves a bottom-sheet-only primitive. Apart from the import rewrite it is byte-identical to the shipped file. I read it from shadcn-ui/ui `apps/v4/public/r/styles/default/drawer.json` through raw.githubusercontent.com; `ui.shadcn.com` is not reachable from here.
  - Only the `new-york-v4` style keys `DrawerContent` on `data-vaul-drawer-direction`. Re-syncing this one primitive to that style would change every bottom-sheet user:
    - function components with `data-slot`;
    - an overlay of `bg-black/50` with animations;
    - `max-h-[80vh]` on the bottom sheet;
    - different header and title classes;
    - no `shouldScaleBackground` default.

    So it is not the cleaner route.
- **Making it harder for AI to write mistakes.** The call that declared a direction the primitive does not draw is gone. This PR adds no metadata and no fallback. The primitive still ignores `direction`, and the SDUI `drawer` node's declared `direction` still reaches it. That is measured and recorded under Acceptance notes. It is left to its own card: choosing between patching the primitive and pointing that node at `Sheet` shapes a public metadata contract.
- **Startup-stage focus.** This touches one package. It adds no export, prop, type member or language-pack key, and no patch family, fixture or gate.

**The phone half.** Before this PR the phone got a bottom sheet with direction `right`: it slid in from the right and was swiped right to close. It now slides up and is dragged down to close. It is also no longer capped by `sm:max-w-2xl`, which between 640px and 767px left it pinned to the left. The 700px row below measures this.

## Pins (jsdom-class environment: classes and data attributes, no layout)

New file `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.drawerDirection-11775.test.tsx`:

- **THE FIX** for create, edit and view at 1440px. The form's `[role="dialog"]`:
  - is not a vaul drawer;
  - carries `inset-y-0 right-0 h-full`;
  - carries none of `inset-x-0 bottom-0 rounded-t-[10px]`;
  - carries `w-full sm:max-w-2xl`, not the Sheet's default `sm:max-w-sm`.
- **CONTROL** for create, edit and view at 390px. The form is on a vaul drawer with `data-vaul-drawer-direction="bottom"` and the bottom-sheet classes, and has no `right-0` and no `sm:max-w-2xl`.
- **CONTROL** for an unrelated user: the stock `DrawerContent`, which `useActionModal`'s `bottom` placement and the SDUI `drawer` node render, still draws the bottom sheet.

Two existing pins found "the drawer" by `[data-vaul-drawer]`: `ObjectView.pageSurfaceFallback-11015.test.tsx` and `ObjectView.splitPopoverCreate-10975.test.tsx`. Their helper now accepts either drawer surface, a right-anchored dialog or a vaul drawer. Their assertions are unchanged. They stay green under the ablation below, which is correct: they pin which surface opens, not its direction.

## Ablation (one-time, nothing committed)

The fix was committed first (`fa16463`). `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` from the objectstack checkout then swapped the new `renderDrawerForm` back to the base markup (anchor 1 → 0, blob `46fbd4ed441f` → `b4542c644a0b`). It ran the three test files and restored the file: the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

- **Base markup:** `Tests 6 failed | 21 passed (27)`. All three desktop THE FIX rows failed with "the desktop form is still on vaul's drawer, whose content is styled as a bottom sheet". All three phone controls failed with "expected 'right' to be 'bottom'". The stock control and both existing pins stayed green.
- **This PR:** `Tests 27 passed (27)`.

## Real-browser reading (Chromium at `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`)

The harness was temporary and is removed: a console Vite entry that mounts `ObjectView` with `layout: 'drawer'` on an in-memory data source. It ran on a dev server I started and then stopped. The script clicks New and reads the `[role="dialog"]` box after the open animation. The base markup was read in the same harness through the same ablation tool, and the file was restored afterwards.

| viewport | base markup | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| 1440×900 | x=0 y=600, 672×300, vaul `right` | x=768 y=0, 672×900, `Sheet` |
| 390×844 | x=0 y=496, 390×348, vaul `right` | x=0 y=496, 390×348, vaul `bottom` |
| 700×900 | x=0 y=600, 672×300, vaul `right` | x=0 y=600, 700×300, vaul `bottom` |

The base desktop reading has the card's shape: bottom-left and 672px wide. The card's 526px height came from a larger form.

## Local gates (all on `fa16463`, the PR head)

| command | exit | the gate's own verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-view/` | 0 | `Test Files 67 passed (67)` · `Tests 623 passed (623)` |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-view type-check` | 0 | `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, no output. `--listFiles` on the test program includes all 3 touched test files. Run after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-view^...'`: 15 tasks, 13 from cache, exit 0 |
| `pnpm exec eslint` on the 4 touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files, `--format json` | 0 | 4 files, 0 errors. Warnings are the same as at the base: 61 on `ObjectView.tsx`, 2 on the 10975 test, 0 on the 11015 test, 0 on the new test |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | 0 | `OK (scanned 7780 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary)` |
| `pnpm check:test-path-roots` | 0 | `check-test-path-roots: OK` |
| `pnpm check:changeset-claims` | 0 | `No pending changeset names a file this change touches.` |
| `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` | 0 | `No test source names a pending changeset.` |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | 0 | `0 new citation(s), enforcement report-only` |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 | `4 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)` |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` | 0 | `No changeset declares a major bump.` |

Lint was run on the touched files only. That narrowing is a measurement, not a skipped run:
- **Population:** `eslint.config.js` lints `**/*.{ts,tsx}`, and this diff touches 4 such files, counted from the `--format json` output.
- **Invariance:** the config enables no type-aware linting (zero hits for `projectService`, `parserOptions` or `project:`). So this diff cannot move the verdict on any file it does not touch.

The diff adds and removes no `export` line. The same grep finds 8 export lines in `ObjectView.tsx` as a positive control. So no package outside `plugin-view` owes a re-test. Repo-wide lint and the test farm are CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **The SDUI `drawer` node meets the same primitive.** Not filed: the bar for filing is not met (see the reach line). I measured this in-process: a real `SchemaRenderer` and the real registry in the `dom` project, through a probe that was not committed.
  - An authored `direction: 'right'` stamps `data-vaul-drawer-direction="right"` but draws the bottom-sheet classes.
  - With no `direction`, it stamps `bottom`, while the JSDoc on `DrawerSchema.direction` says `@default 'right'`.
  - The docs page `content/docs/components/overlay/drawer.mdx` shows a `side` member that `DrawerSchema` does not declare. An authored `side: 'right'` stamps `bottom`.
  - Reach for filing is not met. This is an in-process reading only, and no producer in the tree authors `direction` or `side` on a `drawer` node; the catalog's `basic-drawer.json` authors neither. Carrier: none.
- **`navigation.width` on this drawer probably does nothing (not measured).** `formWidthClass` builds a `max-w-[N...]` class string at runtime. Tailwind generates classes it finds in source, so an authored `navigation.width` probably draws nothing unless that exact class exists elsewhere. The desktop behaviour is the same before and after this PR. `NavigationOverlay` carries its width through a CSS custom property instead. Carrier: none.
- **Tall forms on the phone (not measured).** The phone bottom sheet keeps upstream's `h-auto` with no max height, and this PR does not change that. A form taller than the viewport was not measured here.
- **No docs edit.** The README and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx` call this surface "the drawer" and name no edge. Nothing they say is false after this PR, and both files are outside the claimed surface.
